meta.verification_note: License status for every provider below was verified directly against the official CSLB (Contractors State License Board) license-detail page on 2026-11-06 (data-as-of timestamps shown per row). Review counts/ratings are recorded exactly as displayed on the linked page on 2026-11-06; Yelp blocks automated fetches (HTTP 403), so Yelp figures come from the listing as surfaced in the search index and are flagged for manual re-verification (F-04). No field was inferred.
meta.cslb_note: CSLB states license status can change at any time; re-check the linked CSLB page before signing any contract.
